caption: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, golden broth glowing warmly under soft lighting. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and corn, the ingredients are artfully arranged in a white bowl with blue floral patterns, set against a wooden table.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, reddish-brown wooden surface with visible grain patterns and a warm, slightly reflective finish.
Chashu pork: golden-brown, tender-looking slices with crispy edges and visible fat marbling, slightly curled at the ends.
The miso broth is vibrant orange-yellow, smooth with visible noodles and toppings, forming a circular pool with slight surface ripples.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, sliced pieces with visible fibrous texture and curved, irregular edges.
White ceramic ramen bowl with blue floral and Japanese text patterns along its rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and rounded tip, partially submerged in ramen broth.
